name: MCP Sentinel Approval
description: Optional human-approval gate: queues governed destructive operations (bulk delete) as approval requests for an authorized human to approve or deny.
project_description: MCP Sentinel Approval is an optional submodule of MCP Sentinel. It inserts a human-in-the-loop gate in front of governed destructive operations performed by AI agents: instead of executing immediately, a gated operation (delete, config import, module disable, or a break-glass admin grant) is recorded as an mcp_approval_request content entity and queued for a human with the 'approve mcp sentinel operations' permission to approve or deny. On approval the sealed, HMAC-bound action manifest is replayed with a fresh access re-check and idempotency guard; on denial nothing is touched. It also manages a time-boxed, non-standing mcp_admin break-glass role for incident response, with strict separation of duties: the break-glass role is never is_admin, holds only an enumerated allowlist of permissions, and cannot itself approve operations.
